translation.question: Ni sehemu gani ya programu ya TIFF iliyoorodheshwa chini ya kichwa chake yenyewe katika orodha ya tamasha la mwaka 2025?

backtranslation_en.question: Which section of the TIFF program is listed under its own heading in the 2025 festival list?
